dedupe_keys.name: data for let the sun in clean energy is the cheapest way to meet rising demand

description: Energy Innovation deposits the Switch model inputs, configuration and outputs used for a June 2026 US clean-energy load-growth study. The Zenodo archive covers a 2025 base and 2030 clean-energy and resource-adequacy cases, with separate Unix and Windows files. Its README says a minimal model can be assembled with Switch 2.0.9 from the archived input and output ZIPs; upstream PowerGenome preparation and reporting scripts are in a linked study repository. The files are public under Zenodo CC BY 4.0, while GitHub does not classify the linked repository licence. The existing catalogue Switch record covers the general optimisation software; this deposit is a specific national model instance. A modeller could compare capacity-expansion and reliability scenarios, but the linked README says capacity runs need 32 to 64 GB RAM and commercial-grade solvers, while resource adequacy needs a cluster. The many-gigabyte ZIPs were not downloaded or run, and reproduction of study conclusions is unverified.
inputs: US 2025 and 2030 Switch model case inputs
